By quarreling with traditional American allies or sinking deeper into the war in Iran, Mr. Trump is weakening his country's global standing and pulling troops away from the Pacific. 分析人士说，每当特朗普的注意力转向其他地方，中国都会从中受益。无论是与美国的传统盟友发生争执，还是在伊朗战争中越陷越深，特朗普都在削弱美国的全球地位，并将军力从太平洋地区撤离。 “Xi would love to tell Trump, ‘Go on, stay the course,’” said Suisheng Zhao, executive director of the China Center at the University of Denver. “For Xi, Trump represents a window of opportunity for China, so his priority is to buy more time.” “习近平巴不得对特朗普说，‘继续吧，照这个路子走下去，’”丹佛大学中国中心主任赵穗生说。“对习近平来说，特朗普给中国带来了一个机会窗口，所以他的首要任务就是争取更多时间。” An Emboldened Xi Heads to Washington 习近平更有底气地前往华盛顿 Since first meeting Mr. Trump at Mar-a-Lago more than nine years ago — a gathering best remembered for being when Mr. Xi learned about U.S. missile strikes on Syria while dining on what Mr. Trump described as the “most beautiful chocolate cake” — Mr. Xi has had an extraordinary amount of time for a Chinese leader to size up his chief geopolitical rival. 自九年多前在 马阿拉歌庄园首次与特朗普会面 以来——那次会晤最令人记忆犹新的一幕是，习近平在品尝特朗普口中“最美味的巧克力蛋糕”时得知了美国对叙利亚实施导弹打击的消息，习近平拥有了一段对中国领导人而言异乎寻常的漫长时间，可以观察和判断自己的主要地缘政治对手。 Early in Mr. Trump’s first term, Mr. Xi was somewhat accommodating toward the American president. In 2018, his government agreed to purchase $200 billion in additional U.S. goods and services to offset a trade imbalance (though Beijing never fully honored that deal.) 在特朗普第一个任期之初，习近平对这位美国总统在一定程度上采取了迁就姿态。2018年，中国政府同意额外购买 2000亿美元 的美国商品与服务，以缓解贸易失衡（尽管北京从未完全兑现这一承诺）。 2017年，特朗普与第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普在佛罗里达州棕榈滩马阿拉歌接待了习近平及夫人彭丽媛。 Last year, Mr. Xi flipped the dynamic between the two superpowers. 去年，习近平扭转了两个超级大国之间的态势。 Faced with Mr. Trump’s Liberation Day tariffs, Mr. Xi was the only world leader who refused to back down, choosing instead to match his opponent with one sky-high tariff after another. Mr. Xi then reached for his ace card by throttling exports of Chinese critical minerals, or rare earths, which companies globally need for modern technologies. Backed into a corner, the Trump administration called for a truce. 面对特朗普的“解放日”关税，习近平是唯一拒绝退让的世界领导人，转而选择一轮又一轮高额关税针锋相对。随后，习近平祭出了杀手锏，限制中国关键矿产（即稀土）的出口——全球企业制造现代科技产品都离不开这些资源。被逼到困境的特朗普政府于是呼吁休战。 It was a payoff years in the making : a rare instance in which Beijing not only withstood U.S. pressure but turned the tables and forced it to relent. Beijing, as a result, is emboldened today and sees itself more as an equal to Washington, analysts say . 这是 多年布局 终于得到的回报：北京不仅顶住了美国的压力，而且扭转了局面，迫使其让步，这是罕见的。 分析人士指出 ，这让今天的北京底气更足，也愈发将自己视为与华盛顿平起平坐的一方。 The Trump administration “thought they could use massive unilateral pressure to force China to make concessions. And that did not occur. In fact, the opposite did,” said Scott Kennedy, a researcher at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington. 特朗普政府“原以为可以通过巨大的单边施压迫使中国让步。但事情并没有这样发展。事实上，结果恰恰相反”，华盛顿战略与国际问题研究中心研究员甘思德(Scott Kennedy)说。 “I think now this is Xi Jinping’s world and we’re all living in it,” he added. “我认为，如今这个世界已经是习近平的世界了，我们不过都生活在其中，”他补充道。 An Unstable Truce 并不稳固的休战 The superpowers should put limits on competition, Mr. Xi’s argument goes, to avoid what he has warned could be a catastrophic clash. To this end, he has pushed a formula he calls “constructive strategic stability.” 按照习近平的主张，两个超级大国应当为竞争设定边界，以避免他警告过可能发生的那种灾难性冲突。为此，他提出了一套称为“建设性战略稳定”的方案。 In practice, what this means is that Beijing wants Washington to accept boundaries on where it can challenge China. 落实到实际层面，这意味着北京希望华盛顿接受一定的边界，明确它在哪些地方不可以挑战中国。 In July, for example, when the U.S. Federal Communications Commission proposed a ban on Chinese-made humanoid robots, China’s Ministry of Commerce invoked the phrase, demanding that Washington roll back the restrictions to preserve “strategic stability.” 例如，今年7月，当美国 联邦通信委员会 提议禁止中国制造的人形机器人时，中国商务部就搬出了这一说法，要求华盛顿撤销限制，以维护“战略稳定”。 2025年，中国杭州宇树科技公司的一场机器人拳击演示。 American analysts view the slogan not as a serious effort at ironing out differences but as an attempt to get Washington to recognize China’s clout and back off. China could apply it to any new U.S. restrictions on chip exports or arms sales to Taiwan. 美国分析人士认为，这一口号并非真正试图弥合分歧，而是要让华盛顿承认中国的实力并作出退让。对于美国今后出台的任何芯片出口限制或对台军售，中国都可能套用这一说法。 “The truce is not constructive because little diplomatic infrastructure is being built,” Mr. Czin of the Brookings Institution said. “It is tactical rather than strategic. And therefore it is inherently unstable.” “这种休战并不具有建设性，因为双方几乎没有建立起什么外交机制，”布鲁金斯学会的秦江南说。“它是战术性的，而非战略性的。因此，它在本质上并不稳定。” Summitry is the Strategy 峰会外交是一种策略 Mr. Xi appears to have calculated that the best way to manage the United States is to engage Mr. Trump in high-profile summits rich in optics but thin in substance. 习近平似乎已经认定，应对美国的最佳方式就是与特朗普举行一场场备受瞩目的峰会——场面十足，实质内容却不多。 The planned meeting on Thursday will be their third face-to-face in less than a year, a pace that could continue with talks in November at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, and at the Group of 20 summit in Miami in December. 计划于周四举行的会晤将是他们在不到一年内第三次面对面会晤。这一节奏可能还会延续：11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会，以及12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团峰会，他们都可能再度会晤。 “Head-of-state diplomacy is the cornerstone of China-U.S. relations,” China’s top diplomat, Wang Yi, told Secretary of State Marco Rubio in a call on Thursday. “元首外交是中美关系的定盘星，”中国最高外交官王毅周四与美国国务卿鲁比奥通话时表示。 特朗普上一次与习近平会见是今年5月在北京。本周的会晤将是两人在不到一年内第三次面对面会谈。 But beyond extending the trade truce, the meetings have produced few breakthroughs. China may agree to more agricultural purchases this week, but expectations are low on issues like A.I. safety or China’s trade imbalances. 但除了延长贸易休战之外，这些会晤几乎没有产生什么突破。中国本周可能同意增加农产品采购，但在人工智能安全或中美贸易失衡等问题上，外界的预期普遍不高。 That is by design, analysts say. Enticing Mr. Trump with the pageantry of summits he seems to relish lowers the risk that he may do something to derail relations — like greenlight a package of arms to Taiwan. 分析人士指出，这正是精心设计的结果。用特朗普似乎乐此不疲的峰会排场来吸引他，可以降低他做出某些可能破坏两国关系举动的风险，比如批准一揽子对台军售方案。 Tellingly, Mr. Trump has avoided criticizing China in the lead-up to the talks, even downplaying a Wall Street Journal report that China had supplied Iran with satellite images of a U.S. base in Jordan where three American troops were killed in an Iranian strike. 颇能说明问题的是，在会谈举行前夕，特朗普一直避免批评中国，甚至淡化处理了 《华尔街日报》的一篇报道 ，该报道称，中国曾向伊朗提供美军在约旦一处基地的卫星图像，而三名美军士兵在伊朗对该基地的袭击中丧生。 The summitry will also serve a domestic purpose for Mr. Xi by burnishing his image at home as a global statesman, during a moment of economic anxiety for many Chinese. It is important for Mr. Xi to demonstrate that he can manage Beijing’s most critical bilateral relationship, analysts say. 这场峰会外交对习近平而言同样具有对内意义：在许多中国民众正为经济前景感到焦虑不安之际，这有助于他在国内塑造自己作为全球政治家的形象。分析人士指出，对习近平来说，展现自己有能力处理北京最重要的双边关系至关重要。 Mr. Trump is expected to greet Mr. Xi personally on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland when his plane lands on Wednesday. The White House will host Mr. Xi and Peng Liyuan, the first lady, for a state dinner, the first such banquet since King Charles III and Queen Camilla visited in April. 预计特朗普将于周三在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地停机坪亲自迎接习近平。白宫将为习近平和第一夫人彭丽媛举行国宴，这是自今年4月国王查尔斯三世和卡米拉王后到访以来举办的首场国宴。 “Xi wants to be seen by the Chinese public as a highly respected, influential and consequential world leader — and nothing can top being wined and dined at the White House,” said Minxin Pei, a professor at Claremont McKenna College who studies Chinese leadership politics. “习近平希望，在中国民众眼中，自己是一位备受尊敬、极具影响力、举足轻重的世界领导人，而没有什么比在白宫受到盛情款待更能体现这一点了，”研究中国领导层政治的克莱蒙特·麦肯纳学院教授裴敏欣说。 “Xi cannot afford to be distracted by a huge confrontation with the United States,” Mr. Pei said. “习近平承受不起与美国爆发大规模对抗从而分散精力的代价，”裴敏欣说道。 Berry Wang对本文有研究贡献。 David Pierson 报道中国外交政策和中国与世界的经济与文化交互。他从事新闻工作已超过20年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 美国再一次误判中国的毁灭性代价
description: ROBERT D. KAPLAN2026年9月22日 Before Iran, before Iraq, before Afghanistan there is no country that America has gotten as wrong as China. If this is mystifying, it is only because historical memories are short. America struggled through the previous fiascos. Getting it wrong again would be catastrophic. This is why it is crucial that President Trump strike the right balance in his summit this week with China’s leader, Xi Jinping. 在误判伊朗、伊拉克和阿富汗之前，没有哪个国家像中国这样，让美国产生如此严重的误判。如果这令人费解，那仅仅是因为人们的历史记忆太短暂。美国跌跌撞撞地熬过了一次次重大失策。若再次犯错，将是灾难性的。正因为如此，本周在与中国领导人习近平的峰会上，特朗普总统对分寸的拿捏至关重要。 During World War II, the United States backed China’s Chiang Kai-shek against the Japanese fascists who had invaded in the 1930s. The Roosevelt administration assumed that China under Chiang’s Nationalists would constitute one of the Big Four powers after World War II, along with the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union. When the Chinese Communists under Mao Zedong swept to victory in the 1946-1949 civil war, Washington was shocked that a movement it had barely acknowledged had toppled the beloved Chiang. It was also enraged that the Soviet Union and China were now both in Communist hands. Someone had to be held to account. 第二次世界大战期间，美国支持中国的蒋介石对抗20世纪30年代入侵的日本法西斯。罗斯福政府设想，由蒋介石的国民党领导的中国将在二战后与美国、英国和苏联并列成为“四大国”之一。当毛泽东领导下的中国共产党在1946至1949年的内战中取得全面胜利时，华盛顿大惊失色——一个它几乎未曾正眼相看的运动竟然推翻了备受推崇的蒋介石。同时，华盛顿也对中苏两国双双落入共产党之手感到愤怒。必须有人为此承担责任。 Thus was born the “who lost China?” debate, a critical element of the Red Scare of the 1950s. The State Department officials held to account were precisely the ones who during World War II had been warning, to no avail, that the Communists were likely to militarily triumph. Rather than being celebrated for their clairvoyance, these officials were denounced as traitors whose weak support for the Nationalists had led to Chiang’s fall. The idea that the State Department could have prevented a Communist takeover across a landscape of 550 million people — 37 times the population of South Vietnam during our war there — gravely misjudged the limits of American power. “谁弄丢了中国？”的争论由此诞生，并成为20世纪50年代“红色恐慌”的关键组成部分。被追究责任的国务院官员恰恰是那些在二战期间一直警告（尽管徒劳无功）共产党可能在军事上获胜的人。这些官员未能因其先见之明而受到赞赏，反而被斥为叛徒，指责他们对国民党支持不力导致了蒋介石的倒台。这种认为国务院本可以在一片5.5亿人口的广袤土地上阻止共产党夺取政权的想法是对美国实力的严重误判。5.5亿人是越南战争期间南越人口的37倍。 The Foreign Service officers themselves weren’t innocent. Though accurate about Mao’s chances, they misunderstood the nature of his rule. They conceived of Mao’s Communists as benign compared with Chiang’s Nationalists. Based in the Nationalist wartime capital of Chongqing, they knew intimately Chiang’s authoritarian tendencies. They made only short visits to the Communist base camp in Yan’an, visits that were stage-managed by Mao and his propagandist Zhou Enlai. Impressed by the order and discipline of Yan’an, they were blind to Mao’s totalitarianism, which would eventually result in the murder and starvation of as many as 70 million Chinese. 外交人员本身也并非毫无过错。虽然准确判断了毛泽东获胜的几率，但他们误解了其统治的本质。他们认为，相比蒋介石的国民党，毛泽东的共产党并无威胁。由于驻扎在国民党的战时首都重庆，他们对蒋介石的独裁倾向了如指掌。而他们对共产党的延安大本营仅仅进行了短暂访问，这些访问还是由毛泽东及其宣传家周恩来精心安排的。延安的秩序与纪律给他们留下了深刻印象，却让他们对毛泽东的极权主义视而不见，而这种极权主义最终导致了多达7000万中国人遭受杀戮与饥荒。 The 1950s purge of State Department specialists actually lasted into the 1960s. The Vietnam War was encouraged by Europeanists and generalists because the China hands who would have warned against the dangers of guerrilla war in Asia, and who would have noted that Vietnam had never been a puppet of Communist China, were no longer in key positions in government. There is a direct historical link, through China, from the Red Scare of the early 1950s to the fiasco in Vietnam in the middle and late 1960s. 20世纪50年代对国务院专家的清洗实际上一直延续到了60年代。越南战争受到了欧洲事务专家和通才们的鼓动，因为“中国通”们已不再担任政府要职，他们本会警告在亚洲陷入游击战的危险，并会指出越南从来不是共产主义中国傀儡。从20世纪50年代初的红色恐慌到60年代中后期的越南惨败，其间存在着一条因中国而相连的直接历史脉络。 The diplomatic opening to China accomplished by President Richard Nixon and his national security adviser, Henry Kissinger, in 1972 finally ended the Who Lost China debate. China was no longer lost and had instead become a geopolitical chess piece to be played against the Soviet Union. Nixon’s and Kissinger’s conception held until 1989, when the combination of China’s brutal crackdown at Tiananmen Square and the end of the Cold War meant that China was now both reviled, and, with the demise of Communism in Europe, less of an asset. 理查德·尼克松总统及其国家安全顾问亨利·基辛格在1972年实现的对华外交破冰终结了“谁弄丢了中国”的争论。中国不再是被“弄丢的”，而是变成了地缘政治棋盘上用来制衡苏联的一枚棋子。尼克松和基辛格的这一构想一直维持到1989年，当时中国在天安门广场的残酷镇压与冷战结束的双重因素意味着，中国不仅遭到唾弃，而且随着欧洲共产主义的终结，其作为一项资产的价值也大打折扣。 It was China’s economic and technological flourishing, particularly in the 1990s, that required the United States to treat the country as a great power. So dynamic were Jiang Zemin and his deputy Zhu Rongji that both Democrats and Republicans assumed that if China were admitted to the World Trade Organization, the country would be on a path toward a capitalistic and liberal society. President Bill Clinton held this view — and he was far from alone. 而使美国必须将中国作为大国来对待的是中国的经济与技术繁荣，尤其是在20世纪90年代。江泽民和他的副手朱镕基展现出了极大魄力，以至于民主党和共和党都认为，如果允许中国加入世界贸易组织(WTO)，它将走上一条通往资本主义和自由社会的道路。比尔·克林顿总统持有这种观点——但绝非只有他一人。 That was Washington’s third misjudgment. The Washington establishment — the wind at its back following the triumphalist end to the Cold War — assumed China would follow Europe’s path toward freedom. Alas, China was not Europe. Admitted to the W.T.O., China would eventually turn back toward full-bore authoritarianism under Xi Jinping. 这是华盛顿的第三次误判。乘着冷战胜利之势，华盛顿建制派理所当然地认为中国会效仿欧洲走向自由之路。遗憾的是，中国不是欧洲。被接纳加入世贸组织后，中国最终在习近平治下重新转向了全面的威权主义。 Each of these mistakes has particular causes. They are also connected by China’s size, complexity and outright cultural difference. Only recently, thanks to pathbreaking scholarship by the Hoover Institution academic Frank Dikötter, have we learned the full story of just how much Stalin was aiding Mao during the civil war, making a Nationalist victory even more remote. Analysis of China, unlike that of the Middle East, is not distorted by intense partisanship, but even for an emotionally detached expert class, China is genuinely hard for the United States to fathom. 这些错误中的每一个都有其具体原因。它们也因中国的规模、复杂性以及彻底的文化差异而交织在一起。直到最近，依靠胡佛研究所学者冯客(Frank Dikötter)开创性的学术研究，我们才充分了解到斯大林在内战期间为毛泽东提供了多少援助，这使得国民党获胜的希望更加渺茫。与对中东的分析不同，对中国的分析并未被强烈的党派偏见所扭曲，但即使对于一个情感抽离的专家阶层来说，中国对美国而言也确实难以看透。 What stabilizes the bilateral relationship has been the deliberately vague understanding concerning Taiwan that emerged from Nixon’s visit, known as the Shanghai Communiqué. That formula signaled that there was only one China and its capital is Beijing, but that neither party would attempt violently to change the status quo on Taiwan. 双方关系的稳定一直靠的是尼克松访华后达成的一项关于台湾的刻意模糊的谅解，即《上海公报》。该方案明确世界上只有一个中国，其首都在北京，但任何一方都不会试图通过暴力改变台湾的现状。 For the first time since 1972, the Shanghai Communiqué may be in particularly serious danger. There have been slip-ups, as when President Joe Biden declared he would defend Taiwan, thus abandoning the Nixon formula of ambiguity. But generally presidents exercised rhetorical restraint. 自1972年以来，《上海公报》可能首次处于极其严重的危险之中。尽管曾经出现过失误，比如乔·拜登总统曾宣布他将保卫台湾，从而放弃了尼克松的模糊方案。但总体而言，历任总统在言辞上都保持了克制。 That is no longer the case in the Trump administration, with the president’s stated position on Taiwan and the Asia-Pacific forever volatile. As for China, it is no longer governed by a mandarinate of enlightened Communist leaders, but by Mr. Xi, a Leninist totalitarian with openly aggressive designs on Taiwan. The guideposts are wobbling. Despite the happy talk at summits, we are back to the Who Lost China era, when fundamental mistakes are possible, this time with incalculable consequences. In addition, because neither China nor the United States seems interested in cooperating to regulate A.I., competition over the technology is poised to further destabilize the relationship. 特朗普政府时期情况已不再如此，总统在台湾和亚太问题上的公开立场总是变幻莫测。至于中国，它不再由开明的共产主义领导人组成的官僚阶层统治，而是由习近平这个对台湾抱有公开侵略意图的列宁主义极权统治者来统治。规则的路标正在动摇。尽管峰会上充满了乐观言辞，我们却又回到了“谁弄丢了中国”的时代，在这个时代可能犯下根本性错误，而这一次将带来无法估量的后果。此外，由于中美两国似乎都无意合作监管人工智能，围绕该技术的竞争势必将进一步破坏两国关系的稳定。 The ultimate geopolitical catastrophe would be a military conflict over Taiwan and the South China Sea. Avoiding such a conflict is not merely a matter of reducing military tensions. As the Yale Sinologist Odd Arne Westad points out, it was Germany’s assumption that Britain might not come to the aid of its allies in 1914 that helped set off World War I. If China assumes the United States might not come to the aid of Taiwan, that might likewise increase the chances of war. 终极的地缘政治灾难将是围绕台湾和南海爆发军事冲突。避免这种冲突不仅仅是缓解军事紧张局势的问题。正如耶鲁大学汉学家文安立(Odd Arne Westad)所指出的，正是德国在1914年认为英国可能不会援助其盟友的假设助推了第一次世界大战的爆发。如果中国假设美国可能不会援助台湾，那同样可能增加战争的几率。 Wars in Ukraine, Gaza and Iran have led to severe differences of opinion among both the public and the elites, but have not fundamentally changed our lives. A high-end military conflict in the Western Pacific fought between the world’s largest economies would disrupt the most vital supply chains and change our world profoundly. The comparison with World War I is not an exaggeration. 乌克兰、加沙和伊朗的战争导致公众与精英之间产生了严重分歧，但并未从根本上改变我们的生活。如果世界两大经济体在西太平洋爆发高烈度军事冲突，将破坏最至关重要的供应链，并深刻地改变我们的世界。将其与第一次世界大战相提并论毫不夸张。 Who Lost China was born of an obsession and a misunderstanding. In the late 1940s, the obsession was with Communism, which replaced German Nazism and Japanese fascism as America’s principal enemy the moment World War II ended. Then, the United States thought it had the power to save Chiang’s weakened regime in a war fought over thousands of miles of territory. “谁弄丢了中国”的争论源于一种痴迷和误解。在20世纪40年代末，这种痴迷是针对共产主义的，从二战结束那一刻起，共产主义便取代了德国纳粹主义和日本法西斯主义成为美国的主要敌人。当时，美国认为自己有能力在一场跨越数千公里领土的战争中拯救蒋介石被削弱的政权。 The obsession today is again with Communism, in the shape of China overtaking the United States as the world’s greatest military, economic and artificial intelligence power. The misunderstanding is that a softer, less resolute approach to defending Taiwan and our other Asian allies can somehow prevent a war. In reality, such an approach might embolden China to attack the island, leaving the United States in a hair-trigger crisis over the fate of the entire Pacific. 今天的痴迷再次针对共产主义，表现为担忧中国超越美国，成为世界上最强大的军事、经济和人工智能强国。一种误解认为，在保卫台湾和其他亚洲盟友方面采取较为温和、不那么强硬的策略就能避免战争。在现实中，这种做法可能会助长中国攻击台湾的信心，使美国陷入一场一触即发的、关乎整个太平洋命运的危机。 The most important element in preventing a great war is policy discipline. Boring but true, this leads to steady, predictable signaling. America should not want to confuse China, just as China should not want to confuse us. World War I was in part caused by a misreading of intentions. Mr. Trump, by his vacillation — including using military aid to Taiwan as a bargaining chip with China and toying with the abandonment of Asia to a Chinese sphere of influence — irresponsibly encourages the kind of confusion that can lead to war. 预防大国战争最重要的因素是政策纪律性。这听起来枯燥却是事实，它能带来稳定且可预测的信号传递。美国不应试图去迷惑中国，正如中国也不应试图去迷惑我们一样。第一次世界大战的部分原因就是对意图的误判。特朗普通过他的摇摆不定——包括将对台湾的军事援助作为与中国讨价还价的筹码，以及戏谑般地考虑将亚洲让给中国的势力范围——不负责任地助长了那种可能引发战争的困惑。 The historian Barbara Tuchman followed her classic book about the outbreak of World War I in 1966 with “The Proud Tower,” about the glittering, cosmopolitan world of 19th-century Europe, and how its texture and brilliance and naïveté were lost because of the Great War. The theme Tuchman chose for her book was taken from an 1845 Edgar Allan Poe poem: “While from a proud tower in the town/Death looks gigantically down.” 历史学家芭芭拉·塔奇曼在1966年出版了关于一战爆发的经典著作后，又创作了《高塔》(The Proud Tower)。这本书讲述了19世纪那个光辉灿烂、心系天下的欧洲，以及它的肌理、辉煌和天真是如何因那场“大战”而丧失的。塔奇曼为她的书选择的主题取自埃德加·爱伦·坡1845年的一首诗：“而在城中的一座高塔之上，死神正巍然地朝下眺望。” No geopolitical conflict in the world today has the capacity, if miscalculated, of bringing ruin upon us all like the one between the United States and China. China tore through our domestic politics three-quarters of a century ago. It could be worse this time. 当今世界上，没有任何地缘政治冲突像美中之间的冲突这样，一旦出现误判，将给我们所有人带来毁灭。四分之三个世纪前，中国撕裂了我们的国内政治。这一次情况可能会更糟。 Robert D. Kaplan是《中国耳语者：塑造美国对其主要地缘政治对手看法的声音》(“China Whisperers: The Voices That Have Shaped America’s Views of Its Chief Geopolitical Rival”)一书的作者，也是德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的杰出高级讲师。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: ROBERT D. KAPLAN 2026年9月22日 Before Iran, before Iraq, before Afghanistan there is no country that America has gotten as wrong as China. If this is mystifying, it is only because historical memories are short. America struggled through the previous fiascos. Getting it wrong again would be catastrophic. This is why it is crucial that President Trump strike the right balance in his summit this week with China’s leader, Xi Jinping. 在误判伊朗、伊拉克和阿富汗之前，没有哪个国家像中国这样，让美国产生如此严重的误判。如果这令人费解，那仅仅是因为人们的历史记忆太短暂。美国跌跌撞撞地熬过了一次次重大失策。若再次犯错，将是灾难性的。正因为如此，本周在与中国领导人习近平的峰会上，特朗普总统对分寸的拿捏至关重要。 During World War II, the United States backed China’s Chiang Kai-shek against the Japanese fascists who had invaded in the 1930s. The Roosevelt administration assumed that China under Chiang’s Nationalists would constitute one of the Big Four powers after World War II, along with the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union. When the Chinese Communists under Mao Zedong swept to victory in the 1946-1949 civil war, Washington was shocked that a movement it had barely acknowledged had toppled the beloved Chiang. It was also enraged that the Soviet Union and China were now both in Communist hands. Someone had to be held to account. 第二次世界大战期间，美国支持中国的蒋介石对抗20世纪30年代入侵的日本法西斯。罗斯福政府设想，由蒋介石的国民党领导的中国将在二战后与美国、英国和苏联并列成为“四大国”之一。当毛泽东领导下的中国共产党在1946至1949年的内战中取得全面胜利时，华盛顿大惊失色——一个它几乎未曾正眼相看的运动竟然推翻了备受推崇的蒋介石。同时，华盛顿也对中苏两国双双落入共产党之手感到愤怒。必须有人为此承担责任。 Thus was born the “who lost China?” debate, a critical element of the Red Scare of the 1950s. The State Department officials held to account were precisely the ones who during World War II had been warning, to no avail, that the Communists were likely to militarily triumph. Rather than being celebrated for their clairvoyance, these officials were denounced as traitors whose weak support for the Nationalists had led to Chiang’s fall. The idea that the State Department could have prevented a Communist takeover across a landscape of 550 million people — 37 times the population of South Vietnam during our war there — gravely misjudged the limits of American power. “谁弄丢了中国？”的争论由此诞生，并成为20世纪50年代“红色恐慌”的关键组成部分。被追究责任的国务院官员恰恰是那些在二战期间一直警告（尽管徒劳无功）共产党可能在军事上获胜的人。这些官员未能因其先见之明而受到赞赏，反而被斥为叛徒，指责他们对国民党支持不力导致了蒋介石的倒台。这种认为国务院本可以在一片5.5亿人口的广袤土地上阻止共产党夺取政权的想法是对美国实力的严重误判。5.5亿人是越南战争期间南越人口的37倍。 The Foreign Service officers themselves weren’t innocent. Though accurate about Mao’s chances, they misunderstood the nature of his rule. They conceived of Mao’s Communists as benign compared with Chiang’s Nationalists. Based in the Nationalist wartime capital of Chongqing, they knew intimately Chiang’s authoritarian tendencies. They made only short visits to the Communist base camp in Yan’an, visits that were stage-managed by Mao and his propagandist Zhou Enlai. Impressed by the order and discipline of Yan’an, they were blind to Mao’s totalitarianism, which would eventually result in the murder and starvation of as many as 70 million Chinese. 外交人员本身也并非毫无过错。虽然准确判断了毛泽东获胜的几率，但他们误解了其统治的本质。他们认为，相比蒋介石的国民党，毛泽东的共产党并无威胁。由于驻扎在国民党的战时首都重庆，他们对蒋介石的独裁倾向了如指掌。而他们对共产党的延安大本营仅仅进行了短暂访问，这些访问还是由毛泽东及其宣传家周恩来精心安排的。延安的秩序与纪律给他们留下了深刻印象，却让他们对毛泽东的极权主义视而不见，而这种极权主义最终导致了多达7000万中国人遭受杀戮与饥荒。 The 1950s purge of State Department specialists actually lasted into the 1960s. The Vietnam War was encouraged by Europeanists and generalists because the China hands who would have warned against the dangers of guerrilla war in Asia, and who would have noted that Vietnam had never been a puppet of Communist China, were no longer in key positions in government. There is a direct historical link, through China, from the Red Scare of the early 1950s to the fiasco in Vietnam in the middle and late 1960s. 20世纪50年代对国务院专家的清洗实际上一直延续到了60年代。越南战争受到了欧洲事务专家和通才们的鼓动，因为“中国通”们已不再担任政府要职，他们本会警告在亚洲陷入游击战的危险，并会指出越南从来不是共产主义中国傀儡。从20世纪50年代初的红色恐慌到60年代中后期的越南惨败，其间存在着一条因中国而相连的直接历史脉络。 The diplomatic opening to China accomplished by President Richard Nixon and his national security adviser, Henry Kissinger, in 1972 finally ended the Who Lost China debate. China was no longer lost and had instead become a geopolitical chess piece to be played against the Soviet Union. So dynamic were Jiang Zemin and his deputy Zhu Rongji that both Democrats and Republicans assumed that if China were admitted to the World Trade Organization, the country would be on a path toward a capitalistic and liberal society. President Bill Clinton held this view — and he was far from alone. 而使美国必须将中国作为大国来对待的是中国的经济与技术繁荣，尤其是在20世纪90年代。江泽民和他的副手朱镕基展现出了极大魄力，以至于民主党和共和党都认为，如果允许中国加入世界贸易组织(WTO)，它将走上一条通往资本主义和自由社会的道路。比尔·克林顿总统持有这种观点——但绝非只有他一人。 That was Washington’s third misjudgment. The Washington establishment — the wind at its back following the triumphalist end to the Cold War — assumed China would follow Europe’s path toward freedom. Alas, China was not Europe. They are also connected by China’s size, complexity and outright cultural difference. Only recently, thanks to pathbreaking scholarship by the Hoover Institution academic Frank Dikötter, have we learned the full story of just how much Stalin was aiding Mao during the civil war, making a Nationalist victory even more remote. Analysis of China, unlike that of the Middle East, is not distorted by intense partisanship, but even for an emotionally detached expert class, China is genuinely hard for the United States to fathom. 这些错误中的每一个都有其具体原因。它们也因中国的规模、复杂性以及彻底的文化差异而交织在一起。直到最近，依靠胡佛研究所学者冯客(Frank Dikötter)开创性的学术研究，我们才充分了解到斯大林在内战期间为毛泽东提供了多少援助，这使得国民党获胜的希望更加渺茫。与对中东的分析不同，对中国的分析并未被强烈的党派偏见所扭曲，但即使对于一个情感抽离的专家阶层来说，中国对美国而言也确实难以看透。 What stabilizes the bilateral relationship has been the deliberately vague understanding concerning Taiwan that emerged from Nixon’s visit, known as the Shanghai Communiqué. Avoiding such a conflict is not merely a matter of reducing military tensions. title: “习特会”在即，中美贸易“暗战”小动作不断
description: ANA SWANSON2026年9月22日特朗普总统与中国领导人习近平去年在韩国釜山会面。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times When the United States and China reached a trade truce during a meeting in South Korea a year ago, it helped restore some stability to an economic relationship that was threatening to spin out of control. 一年前，美国和中国在韩国举行的会议上达成贸易休战，这有助于为两国面临失控危险的经济关系恢复一些稳定性。 The agreement forced President Trump to walk back punishing tariffs on Chinese exports, and made China promise to maintain exports of critical minerals that it had cut off in response to the president’s levies. 这项协议迫使特朗普总统撤回了对中国出口商品的惩罚性关税，并促使中国承诺维持关键矿产的出口，此前中国为回应特朗普关税而切断了这些矿产的出口。 Negotiators appear to be preparing to extend that agreement as Xi Jinping, the leader of China, comes to Washington to meet with Mr. Trump later this week. On Sunday night, U.S. officials said that they would discuss setting up a dialogue on artificial intelligence and promoting trade in nonsensitive goods like energy and consumer products when Mr. Trump meets Mr. Xi this week. 随着中国领导人习近平将于本周晚些时候来到华盛顿与特朗普会晤，谈判代表们似乎正准备延长该协议。周日晚上，美国官员表示，在特朗普与习近平于本周会晤时，他们将讨论建立人工智能对话机制，并促进能源和消费品等非敏感商品的贸易。 But despite the plans for a warm state dinner and other pomp and circumstance at the White House, the truce between the United States and China has been uneasier than it might appear. It has not prevented either government from continuing to take action against one another in ways that have sometimes threatened to upset the agreement entirely. Both nations have blamed each other for violating promises made last October in Korea. 但是，尽管白宫计划举行热烈的国宴和其他隆重仪式，美中之间的休战比表面上看起来更加令人不安。它并未阻止两国政府继续采取针对彼此的行动，这些行动有时险些彻底破坏该协议。两国都指责对方违反了去年10月在韩国做出的承诺。 U.S. officials say that China’s exports of many minerals necessary for cars, semiconductors and power tools are still overly restricted, leaving some companies uncertain about their supplies. China’s purchases of farm goods lag behind promised levels. And U.S. companies have also been deeply worried about a series of decrees that China’s State Council has issued since March, which expanded the Chinese government’s power over global companies that operate in China. 美国官员表示，中国对汽车、半导体和电动工具所需的许多矿产的出口仍然受到过度限制，导致部分企业对供应状况感到担忧。中国对农产品的采购落后于承诺的水平。此外，美国公司也对中国国务院自3月以来发布的一系列法令深感担忧，这些法令扩大了中国政府对在华运营的跨国公司的权力。 The rules restrict the unauthorized auditing of supply chains in China — something that is necessary for firms to comply with forced labor laws — and penalize firms for complying with foreign sanctions against Chinese firms. They also tighten state oversight for outbound investments and mineral exports, raising the question of how much influence Beijing will exert over global business. 这些规定限制了对中国境内供应链的未经授权的审计——此类审计是企业遵守强迫劳动法所必需的，并处罚那些遵守针对中国企业实施的外国制裁的企业。这些规定还加强了对对外投资和矿产出口的国家监管，这引发了北京将对全球商业施加多大影响的疑问。 American officials have also continued to bar more Chinese technology from the United States, from routers to humanoid robots. The United States has recently accused China of copying American A.I. models through what it has labeled “industrial distillation.” 美国官员也继续禁止更多中国技术进入美国，从路由器到类人机器人。美国最近指责中国通过其所谓的“工业级蒸馏”复制美国的人工智能模型。 In June, the U.S. added a slew of major Chinese firms to a list of Chinese military companies. And in July, the Trump administration added dozens of Chinese companies to a trade blacklist related to forced labor. 今年6月，美国将一批大型中国企业列入中国军方企业名单。7月，特朗普政府又将数十家中国公司列入与强迫劳动相关的贸易黑名单。 In response, China sanctioned seven U.S. firms that help companies verify and map out their supply chains, including testing for cotton grown in Xinjiang, which the United States banned because of concerns about forced labor. The dueling regulations have put companies in a bind, since engaging in the supply chain checks required by U.S. law mean they could be penalized in China. 作为回应，中国制裁了七家帮助企业验证和规划其供应链的美国公司，这些工作中包括对新疆棉花进行检测——美国出于对强迫劳动的担忧禁止了这种棉花。这些相互冲突的规定让企业陷入了进退两难的境地，因为如果按照美国法律的要求进行供应链核查，就可能在中国受到处罚。 The moves, some say, have been calibrated to fly under Mr. Trump’s radar and not upset the overall relationship. But they are still harmful to companies on both sides of the Pacific, and a reflection of the deep challenges in the bilateral relationship that go beyond any rapport between Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi. 有人认为，这些举措经过了精心计算，旨在不引起特朗普的注意，以免影响两国整体关系。但它们仍然对太平洋两岸的企业造成了损害，并反映了双边关系中存在的深层次挑战，这些挑战超越了特朗普与习近平之间的融洽关系所能解决的范畴。 “The overall relationship comes down from the top, and President Trump, Xi Jinping have a very good relationship,” Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who leads negotiations with China, said in an interview with FOX Business in July. “But, you know, that’s not an excuse for them to do things underneath the surface,” he said, referring to the Chinese. “整体关系是自上而下的，特朗普总统和习近平有着非常好的关系，”负责对华谈判的财政部长贝森特7月接受福克斯商业频道采访时说。“但是，你知道，这不能成为他们在私下里搞小动作的借口，”他在提到中方时说。 Mr. Bessent said he sometimes described the relationship as “a water polo match” where leaders were hitting the ball back and forth. But under the water, the Chinese were doing “a lot of kicking,” he said, adding, “if we have to, we’ll kick back.” 贝森特说，他有时将这种关系形容为“水球比赛”，领导人们在水面上将球打来打去。但在水下，中国人却在做着“大量的踢腿动作”，他还说，“如果必要，我们也会踢回去。” An editorial in August in the China Daily, a state-run publication, agreed that it was a “perfect metaphor” but called it “an almost perfect inversion of reality,” saying that the United States was the one instigating the kicking. 中国官方媒体《中国日报》在8月的社论中同意这是一个“绝妙的比喻”，但称其“几乎完全颠倒了现实”，表示美国才是挑起踢腿的一方。 Ryan Hass, the director of the John L. Thornton China Center at the Brookings Institution, a Washington think tank, said there was “still room for shin-kicking under the table,” but “there are limits to how hard the kicking can occur.” 华盛顿智库布鲁金斯学会约翰·L·桑顿中国中心主任何瑞恩(Ryan Hass)表示，“在桌子底下仍然有互相踢小腿的空间”，但是“踢的力度是有限度的”。 Mr. Hass, at a Brookings panel last week, said that the “gentlemen’s agreement” the leaders had reached in South Korea set parameters around highly sensitive issues like tech restrictions, tariffs and behavior toward Taiwan, but did not restrict the countries’ actions in other areas. 何瑞恩在上周的一次布鲁金斯学会小组讨论会上表示，两国领导人在韩国达成的“君子协定”为技术限制、关税和对台行为等高度敏感问题设定了界限，但并未限制两国在其他领域的行动。 “For the last many months, what we’ve seen is kind of a testing and probing by both sides to understand what can be done competitively while still keeping that leader-level rapprochement on track,” Mira Rapp-Hooper, a visiting fellow at Brookings, said at the same event. 布鲁金斯学会客座研究员米拉·拉普-胡珀在同一场活动中表示：“过去几个月里，我们看到双方都在进行某种试探和摸索，以了解在保持领导人层面关系缓和的同时在竞争层面可以采取哪些行动。” “I don’t think any of us can predict with any certainty how long an arrangement like this could go,” she said, calling it “an extremely unique way to handle a great power relationship.” “我认为我们谁都无法确切预测这样的安排能持续多久，”她说，并称这是“处理大国关系的一种极其独特的方式”。 Officials on both sides will be focused on positive announcements next week. The United States is pushing for China to fulfill promises made earlier this year to buy U.S. farm goods and Boeing airplanes. 双方官员将把焦点放在下周发布积极声明上。美国正在敦促中国兑现今年早些时候做出的购买美国农产品和波音飞机的承诺。 Both countries appear interested in making progress to set up a new “board of trade” that could lower tariffs on $30 billion of goods on each side. And analysts are watching to see how much progress the meetings will make on issues like A.I. safety and the war in Iran, and whether they will address Taiwan or Chinese investment in the United States. 两国似乎都希望在建立新的“贸易委员会”方面取得进展，该委员会可以降低双方各300亿美元商品的关税。分析人士正在密切关注，这些会议将在人工智能安全和伊朗战争等问题上取得多少进展，以及双方是否会讨论台湾或中国在美投资问题。 But most analysts believe the biggest focus of the trip will be ensuring that basic stability between the countries continues. China has pushed for a longer extension of the current trade truce, which expires in November, but the U.S. has proposed it be extended for just six months to keep negotiations on a tighter leash, people familiar with the negotiations say. 但大多数分析人士认为，此行的最大重点将是确保两国间的基本稳定得以持续。据熟悉谈判情况的人士透露，中方推动将于11月到期的当前贸易休战期进一步延长，但美国提议仅延长六个月，以便对谈判保持更严格的控制。 In a briefing with reporters Friday, an administration official declined to say whether the truce would be extended, saying that it would be on the agenda for the meeting. The official also said that China’s performance in supplying the U.S. and global economy with rare earths had not been up to U.S. expectations and would be discussed, along with topics like A.I. safety and China’s role in the U.S. fentanyl crisis. 在周五的记者会上，一位政府官员拒绝透露是否会延长贸易休战协议，并表示这将列入会议议程。该官员还表示，中国在向美国和全球经济供应稀土方面的表现没有达到美国的期望，这一问题也将被纳入讨论，还有人工智能安全以及中国在美国芬太尼危机中的角色等话题。 The meetings this week could simply lay the groundwork for an extension of the truce, with any announcement coming later. In an interview with the Financial Times on Sunday, U.S. officials said that the trade truce didn’t officially expire until Nov. 30, so it wasn’t critical it be extended immediately. 本周的会谈可能只是为延长休战奠定基础，任何公告都将在晚些时候发布。在周日接受《金融时报》采访时，美国官员表示，贸易休战协议要到11月30日才正式到期，因此无需立即延长。 Sara Schuman, a former U.S. trade official and a managing director at Beacon Global Strategies, said the Chinese would like to see the truce extended for as long as possible, but the United States wants more frequent renegotiations that would allow it to press China on commitments that have not been fulfilled. 前美国贸易官员、灯塔全球战略咨询公司董事总经理莎拉·舒曼表示，中方希望休战尽可能延长，但美国希望进行更频繁的重新谈判，以便就中国尚未履行的承诺向其施压。 “From the U.S. perspective, right now China is just barely squeaking through on its commitments on critical minerals and rare earths,” Ms. Schuman said. “My expectation is that there’s a direct correlation between what China offers on critical minerals in this meeting and whether or not the truce is extended, and for how long,” she added. “从美国的角度来看，目前中国在关键矿产和稀土方面的承诺仅勉强达标，”舒曼说。“我预计，中国在本次会议上就关键矿产提出的方案将直接决定休战协议是否延长以及延长多久，”她还说。 Geoffrey Gertz, a senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, a Washington think tank, said there was a “real risk” in the coming months that one side would unintentionally upset the trade truce by crossing what the other party sees as a red line. 华盛顿智库新美国安全中心高级研究员杰弗里·格茨表示，在未来几个月存在一种“真实风险”：一方可能无意中越过另一方视为红线的界限，从而破坏贸易休战。 “I think over time, some type of that miscalculation, misperception is pretty likely,” he said. “我认为，随着时间的推移，出现某种此类误判或误解的可能性相当大，”他说。 Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

The United States is pushing for China to fulfill promises made earlier this year to buy U.S. farm goods and Boeing airplanes. 双方官员将把焦点放在下周发布积极声明上。美国正在敦促中国兑现今年早些时候做出的购买美国农产品和波音飞机的承诺。 Both countries appear interested in making progress to set up a new “board of trade” that could lower tariffs on $30 billion of goods on each side. And analysts are watching to see how much progress the meetings will make on issues like A.I. safety and the war in Iran, and whether they will address Taiwan or Chinese investment in the United States. 两国似乎都希望在建立新的“贸易委员会”方面取得进展，该委员会可以降低双方各300亿美元商品的关税。分析人士正在密切关注，这些会议将在人工智能安全和伊朗战争等问题上取得多少进展，以及双方是否会讨论台湾或中国在美投资问题。 But most analysts believe the biggest focus of the trip will be ensuring that basic stability between the countries continues. China has pushed for a longer extension of the current trade truce, which expires in November, but the U.S. has proposed it be extended for just six months to keep negotiations on a tighter leash, people familiar with the negotiations say. 但大多数分析人士认为，此行的最大重点将是确保两国间的基本稳定得以持续。据熟悉谈判情况的人士透露，中方推动将于11月到期的当前贸易休战期进一步延长，但美国提议仅延长六个月，以便对谈判保持更严格的控制。 In a briefing with reporters Friday, an administration official declined to say whether the truce would be extended, saying that it would be on the agenda for the meeting. The official also said that China’s performance in supplying the U.S. and global economy with rare earths had not been up to U.S. expectations and would be discussed, along with topics like A.I. safety and China’s role in the U.S. fentanyl crisis. 在周五的记者会上，一位政府官员拒绝透露是否会延长贸易休战协议，并表示这将列入会议议程。该官员还表示，中国在向美国和全球经济供应稀土方面的表现没有达到美国的期望，这一问题也将被纳入讨论，还有人工智能安全以及中国在美国芬太尼危机中的角色等话题。 The meetings this week could simply lay the groundwork for an extension of the truce, with any announcement coming later. In an interview with the Financial Times on Sunday, U.S. officials said that the trade truce didn’t officially expire until Nov. 30, so it wasn’t critical it be extended immediately. 本周的会谈可能只是为延长休战奠定基础，任何公告都将在晚些时候发布。在周日接受《金融时报》 采访 时，美国官员表示，贸易休战协议要到11月30日才正式到期，因此无需立即延长。 Sara Schuman, a former U.S. trade official and a managing director at Beacon Global Strategies, said the Chinese would like to see the truce extended for as long as possible, but the United States wants more frequent renegotiations that would allow it to press China on commitments that have not been fulfilled. 前美国贸易官员、灯塔全球战略咨询公司董事总经理莎拉·舒曼表示，中方希望休战尽可能延长，但美国希望进行更频繁的重新谈判，以便就中国尚未履行的承诺向其施压。 “From the U.S. perspective, right now China is just barely squeaking through on its commitments on critical minerals and rare earths,” Ms. Schuman said. “My expectation is that there’s a direct correlation between what China offers on critical minerals in this meeting and whether or not the truce is extended, and for how long,” she added. “从美国的角度来看，目前中国在关键矿产和稀土方面的承诺仅勉强达标，”舒曼说。“我预计，中国在本次会议上就关键矿产提出的方案将直接决定休战协议是否延长以及延长多久，”她还说。 Geoffrey Gertz, a senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, a Washington think tank, said there was a “real risk” in the coming months that one side would unintentionally upset the trade truce by crossing what the other party sees as a red line. 华盛顿智库新美国安全中心高级研究员杰弗里·格茨表示，在未来几个月存在一种“真实风险”：一方可能无意中越过另一方视为红线的界限，从而破坏贸易休战。 “I think over time, some type of that miscalculation, misperception is pretty likely,” he said. “我认为，随着时间的推移，出现某种此类误判或误解的可能性相当大，”他说。 Ana Swanson 报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 人工智能议题中美说了算？联合国被边缘化
description: DUSTIN VOLZ2026年9月22日上周，北京千寻智能公司总部数据训练中心里的员工。人工智能将成为本周联合国大会数场会议的主导议题。 Tingshu Wang/Reuters As the threats posed by artificial intelligence spark international alarm, the stakes of the Chinese leader Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington this week have only grown bigger. 随着人工智能带来的威胁引发国际恐慌，中国领导人习近平本周对华盛顿的国事访问显得非同小可。 Earning considerably less attention are the meetings focused on A.I. at the United Nations General Assembly in New York this week, as world leaders gather in the shadow of several rogue A.I. hacking episodes that have prompted greater fears. 相比之下，本周在纽约联合国大会上聚焦人工智能的会议受到的关注要少得多。此时，各国领导人正聚集在引发更大担忧的几起失控人工智能黑客事件的阴影下。 A.I. will be a dominant theme for a fleet of U.N. meetings on Monday centered on international digital cooperation. The schedule includes discussions about the technology’s risks and opportunities, the potential for economic dislocation and possible international governance. 人工智能将成为周一围绕国际数字合作展开的一系列联合国会议的主导议题。议程包括讨论该技术的风险与机遇、潜在的经济错位以及可能的国际治理方案。 Mr. Xi is expected to skip the General Assembly to instead convene in Washington with President Trump, who has repeatedly dismissed A.I. safety concerns as a hoax. 预计习近平将缺席联合国大会，转而在华盛顿与特朗普总统会面，特朗普已多次将对人工智能安全的担忧斥为骗局。 There is no shortage of tension between the two countries, and A.I. is just one of several issues the two sides are expected to discuss. But few issues are as contentious right now — or as important to humanity, some say — as the race for A.I. dominance. 两国之间紧张对峙频频，且人工智能只是预计双方将讨论的众多问题之一。但一些人表示，眼下很少有哪项议题能像争夺人工智能主导权这样具争议性，或对人类如此重要。 The United States has repeatedly accused Chinese A.I. firms of stealing the intellectual property of American A.I. labs. China, too, continues to agitate against U.S. restrictions on advanced computer chips needed to power A.I. models. 美国已多次指责中国人工智能公司窃取美国人工智能实验室的知识产权。中国也持续抗议美国限制驱动人工智能模型所需的高级计算机芯片。 Some onlookers, though expecting little, compared the urgency for a breakthrough on A.I. safety issues between the world’s two superpowers to the need for nuclear arms control agreements during the Cold War. 尽管期望不高，但一些观察人士仍将两个超级大国在人工智能安全问题上取得突破的紧迫性与冷战期间缔结核军备控制协议的必要性相提并论。 The U.N. gathering and the White House meeting underscore how much A.I. has become a race solely between two rival powers, with the rest of the world largely pushed to the periphery, foreign policy experts said. 外交政策专家表示，联合国大会和白宫会晤凸显出，人工智能在很大程度上已演变为仅在两个竞争大国之间展开的角逐，而世界其他地区基本被推向边缘。 “The U.N., to put it bluntly, has been sidelined in the A.I. conversation,” said Kyle Chan, a foreign policy fellow at the Brookings Institution who studies U.S.- China relations and focuses on technology issues. 布鲁金斯学会研究美中关系并专注于科技问题的外交政策研究员陈凯欣(Kyle Chan)表示：“坦白说，联合国在人工智能对话中已被边缘化。” A.I. is “a two-player game,” Mr. Chan added. “It’s kind of like nuclear weapons: If you do not have them or are not on the verge of having them, it’s hard to be relevant in shaping the discussion.” 人工智能是“两个玩家的游戏，”他还说。“这有点像核武器：如果你没有，或者不是即将拥有它们，就很难在塑造相关讨论时发挥实质性作用。” Reflecting that reality, the United States and China discussed on Sunday creating a notification system to allow for the countries to alert each other about A.I.-driven national security risks. The mechanism, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said, would be called “the U.S.-China A.I. dialogue.” 同样反映这一现实的是，美中两国周日讨论了建立一个通报系统，以便两国互相通报由人工智能引发的国家安全风险。财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，该机制将被命名为“美中人工智能对话”。 It is not for lack of trying. António Guterres, the U.N. secretary general, pushed last week for international cooperation on A.I., highlighting it as one of three existential risks facing humanity alongside climate change and deepening global inequality. 出现这种局面并非因为联合国未作尝试。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯上周大力推动人工智能领域的国际合作，强调它是与气候变化和不断加剧的全球不平等并列的三大人类生存风险之一。 A.I., he said, presents other dangers, including amplifying misinformation, discrimination, privacy violations, cyberattacks and so-called superintelligence that could advance beyond human control. 他指出，人工智能带来了其他危险，包括放大虚假信息、加剧歧视、侵犯隐私、引发网络攻击以及可能发展出脱离人类控制的所谓超级智能。 “We need a shared understanding of how to advance the safe, secure and responsible development of A.I., while identifying when increasingly powerful systems may require stronger safeguards,” Mr. Guterres said. “The world cannot afford a race to the bottom on A.I. safety.” “我们需要就如何安全、可靠且负责任地推进人工智能发展达成共识，同时明确越来越强大的系统何时需要更强有力的保障措施，”古特雷斯表示。“世界承受不起在人工智能安全上竞相探底的后果。” OpenAI的Stargate是美国最大的数据中心项目，位于得克萨斯州阿比林。一位公司发言人表示，该公司首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼将于周三在联合国安全理事会发表演讲。 Under Mr. Guterres, the United Nations has been trying to build international consensus around responsible A.I. development for years, including by forming an advisory body in 2023 to study the issue. And on Monday, the leaders of 22 countries adopted a declaration calling to strengthen “human direction, oversight and control” of A.I. systems. The United States and China did not join the declaration. 在古特雷斯的领导下，联合国多年来一直致力于围绕负责任的人工智能发展凝聚国际共识，包括在2023年成立一个咨询机构专门研究该问题。周一，22个国家的领导人通过了一项宣言，呼吁加强对人工智能系统的“人类指导、监督和控制”。美国和中国均未加入该宣言。 The two countries have only further cemented their leads ahead of everyone else since the U.N. began worrying about A.I., rushing to build out data centers and release cutting-edge A.I. models despite growing fears about existential risks associated with the technology. 自联合国开始关注人工智能以来，美中两国相对其他国家的优势进一步扩大，竞相建设数据中心并发布尖端人工智能模型，尽管外界对该技术相关的生存风险日益担忧。 In his remarks last week, Mr. Guterres acknowledged that “geopolitical divides” made policing A.I. difficult but said that voluntary pauses on the technology would not work if not everyone agreed to them — meaning, right now, the United States and China. 在上周的讲话中，古特雷斯承认“地缘政治分歧”增加了监管人工智能的难度，但他表示，如果不能得到所有人的同意（这意味着目前必须包括美国和中国），暂停研发该技术的自愿呼吁将无法奏效。 China had generally been seeking to increase its influence with the United Nations, but this summer launched the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, which has its headquarters in Shanghai, in a bid to assert global dominance on international A.I. discussions. The United States has shown little interest in building international consensus on A.I. or other geopolitical matters. 中国总体上一直在寻求扩大其在联合国的影响力，但在今年夏天推出了总部设在上海的世界人工智能合作组织，试图主导全球人工智能国际讨论。美国则对在人工智能或其他地缘政治问题上建立国际共识没有表现出多少兴趣。 The U.N. Security Council may hold more sway on A.I. than the General Assembly. The OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman will speak to the Security Council on Wednesday, a company spokeswoman said. But it is difficult to imagine the Security Council — on which the United States, China and Russia sit — forging a consensus, experts said. 联合国安全理事会在人工智能议题上可能比联合国大会更具影响力。一位公司发言人表示，OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼将于周三在安理会发表演讲。但专家指出，很难想象有美、中、俄三国坐镇的安理会能够达成共识。 Mr. Altman’s appearance at the United Nations is just a warm-up. A day later in Washington, he will join a far larger roster of A.I. and technology leaders for the U.S.-China state dinner, including Nvidia’s Jensen Huang, SpaceX’s Elon Musk and the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. 奥特曼在联合国的露面只是一场热身。一天后，他将在华盛顿与阵容更为庞大的人工智能和科技界领袖一同出席美中两国国宴，其中包括英伟达的黄仁勋、SpaceX的埃隆·马斯克以及亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯。 Julian Ku, a professor of constitutional and international law at Hofstra University, said that the United Nations has always struggled to influence superpowers on the uses and limits of weapons they have that others do not, from nukes to high-powered hacking tools. 霍夫斯特拉大学宪法和国际法教授古举伦(Julian Ku)表示，从核弹到高性能黑客工具，在影响超级大国如何使用和限制它们独有的武器方面，联合国历来举步维艰。 In the context of nuclear weapons, that took the form of helping nonnuclear nations gain access to nuclear power while spreading nonproliferation agreements, Mr. Ku said. While the United Nations would like to steer the A.I. safety conversation, it will probably find more success working to ensure the rest of the world is not fully left behind on the benefits societies could reap from the technology, Mr. Ku added. 古举伦指出，在核武器背景下，联合国的努力体现为帮助无核国家获得核能，同时推广不扩散协议。他补充说，尽管联合国希望主导人工智能安全对话，但它可能会发现，不如转而致力于确保世界其他地区不会完全错过从该技术中获得的益处，这样效果会更好。 “In a lot of ways, this is the story of the U.N. from the outset,” Mr. Ku said. “The U.N. can’t really shape the actions of those who have the power directly, but they do have the interests of everyone else who do not have that power.” “在许多方面，这就是联合国自诞生以来的写照，”古举伦说。“联合国无法直接左右那些权力者的行动，但它确实代表了不掌握这种权力的其他各方的利益。” Dustin Volz为时报撰写网络安全和情报方面的文章，他常驻华盛顿。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

The mechanism, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said, would be called “the U.S.-China A.I. dialogue.” 同样反映这一现实的是，美中两国周日讨论了 建立一个通报系统 ，以便两国互相通报由人工智能引发的国家安全风险。财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，该机制将被命名为“美中人工智能对话”。 It is not for lack of trying. António Guterres, the U.N. secretary general, pushed last week for international cooperation on A.I., highlighting it as one of three existential risks facing humanity alongside climate change and deepening global inequality. 出现这种局面并非因为联合国未作尝试。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯上周大力推动人工智能领域的国际合作，强调它是与气候变化和不断加剧的全球不平等并列的三大人类生存风险之一。 A.I., he said, presents other dangers, including amplifying misinformation, discrimination, privacy violations, cyberattacks and so-called superintelligence that could advance beyond human control. 他指出，人工智能带来了其他危险，包括放大虚假信息、加剧歧视、侵犯隐私、引发网络攻击以及可能发展出脱离人类控制的所谓超级智能。 “We need a shared understanding of how to advance the safe, secure and responsible development of A.I., while identifying when increasingly powerful systems may require stronger safeguards,” Mr. Guterres said. “The world cannot afford a race to the bottom on A.I. safety.” “我们需要就如何安全、可靠且负责任地推进人工智能发展达成共识，同时明确越来越强大的系统何时需要更强有力的保障措施，”古特雷斯表示。“世界承受不起在人工智能安全上竞相探底的后果。” OpenAI的Stargate是美国最大的数据中心项目，位于得克萨斯州阿比林。一位公司发言人表示，该公司首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼将于周三在联合国安全理事会发表演讲。 Under Mr. Guterres, the United Nations has been trying to build international consensus around responsible A.I. development for years, including by forming an advisory body in 2023 to study the issue. And on Monday, the leaders of 22 countries adopted a declaration calling to strengthen “human direction, oversight and control” of A.I. systems. The United States and China did not join the declaration. 在古特雷斯的领导下，联合国多年来一直致力于围绕负责任的人工智能发展凝聚国际共识，包括在2023年成立一个咨询机构专门研究该问题。周一，22个国家的领导人通过了 一项宣言 ，呼吁加强对人工智能系统的“人类指导、监督和控制”。美国和中国均未加入该宣言。 The two countries have only further cemented their leads ahead of everyone else since the U.N. began worrying about A.I., rushing to build out data centers and release cutting-edge A.I. models despite growing fears about existential risks associated with the technology. 自联合国开始关注人工智能以来，美中两国相对其他国家的优势进一步扩大，竞相建设数据中心并发布尖端人工智能模型，尽管外界对该技术相关的 生存风险 日益担忧。 In his remarks last week, Mr. Guterres acknowledged that “geopolitical divides” made policing A.I. difficult but said that voluntary pauses on the technology would not work if not everyone agreed to them — meaning, right now, the United States and China. 在上周的讲话中，古特雷斯承认“地缘政治分歧”增加了监管人工智能的难度，但他表示，如果不能得到所有人的同意（这意味着目前必须包括美国和中国），暂停研发该技术的自愿呼吁将无法奏效。 China had generally been seeking to increase its influence with the United Nations, but this summer launched the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, which has its headquarters in Shanghai, in a bid to assert global dominance on international A.I. discussions. The United States has shown little interest in building international consensus on A.I. or other geopolitical matters. 中国总体上一直在寻求扩大其在联合国的影响力，但在今年夏天推出了总部设在上海的世界人工智能合作组织，试图主导全球人工智能国际讨论。美国则对在人工智能或其他地缘政治问题上建立国际共识没有表现出多少兴趣。 The U.N. Security Council may hold more sway on A.I. than the General Assembly. The OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman will speak to the Security Council on Wednesday, a company spokeswoman said. But it is difficult to imagine the Security Council — on which the United States, China and Russia sit — forging a consensus, experts said. 联合国安全理事会在人工智能议题上可能比联合国大会更具影响力。一位公司发言人表示，OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼将于周三在安理会发表演讲。但专家指出，很难想象有美、中、俄三国坐镇的安理会能够达成共识。 Mr. Altman’s appearance at the United Nations is just a warm-up. A day later in Washington, he will join a far larger roster of A.I. and technology leaders for the U.S.-China state dinner, including Nvidia’s Jensen Huang, SpaceX’s Elon Musk and the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. 奥特曼在联合国的露面只是一场热身。一天后，他将在华盛顿与阵容更为庞大的人工智能和科技界领袖一同出席美中两国国宴，其中包括英伟达的黄仁勋、SpaceX的埃隆·马斯克以及亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯。 Julian Ku, a professor of constitutional and international law at Hofstra University, said that the United Nations has always struggled to influence superpowers on the uses and limits of weapons they have that others do not, from nukes to high-powered hacking tools. 霍夫斯特拉大学宪法和国际法教授古举伦(Julian Ku)表示，从核弹到高性能黑客工具，在影响超级大国如何使用和限制它们独有的武器方面，联合国历来举步维艰。 In the context of nuclear weapons, that took the form of helping nonnuclear nations gain access to nuclear power while spreading nonproliferation agreements, Mr. Ku said. While the United Nations would like to steer the A.I. safety conversation, it will probably find more success working to ensure the rest of the world is not fully left behind on the benefits societies could reap from the technology, Mr. Ku added. 古举伦指出，在核武器背景下，联合国的努力体现为帮助无核国家获得核能，同时推广不扩散协议。他补充说，尽管联合国希望主导人工智能安全对话，但它可能会发现，不如转而致力于确保世界其他地区不会完全错过从该技术中获得的益处，这样效果会更好。 “In a lot of ways, this is the story of the U.N. from the outset,” Mr. Ku said. “The U.N. can’t really shape the actions of those who have the power directly, but they do have the interests of everyone else who do not have that power.” “在许多方面，这就是联合国自诞生以来的写照，”古举伦说。“联合国无法直接左右那些权力者的行动，但它确实代表了不掌握这种权力的其他各方的利益。” Dustin Volz 为时报撰写网络安全和情报方面的文章，他常驻华盛顿。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: anthropics/financial-services
description: Claude for Financial Services Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for the financial-services workflows we see most — investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management. Everything here is available two ways from one source: install it as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deploy it through the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine. Same system prompt, same skills — you choose where it runs. Important Nothing in this repository constitutes investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice. These agents draft analyst work product — models, memos, research notes, reconciliations — for review by a qualified professional. They do not make investment recommendations, execute transactions, bind risk, post to a ledger, or approve onboarding; every output is staged for human sign-off. You are responsible for verifying outputs and for compliance with the laws and regulations that apply to your firm. What's in the repo: Agents — named, end-to-end workflow agents (Pitch Agent, Market Researcher, GL Reconciler, …). Each ships as a Cowork plugin and as a Claude Managed Agent template you deploy via /v1/agents. Vertical plugins — the underlying skills, slash commands, and data connectors, bundled by FSI vertical. Install these on their own if you just want /comps, /dcf, /earnings and the connectors without a full agent. Agents Each agent is named for the workflow it runs. They're starting points: install the ones that match your work, then tune the prompts, skills, and connectors to how your firm does it. Each agent plugin is self-contained — it bundles the skills it uses, so installing the agent is all you need. Function Agent What it does Coverage & advisory Pitch Agent Comps, precedents, LBO → branded pitch deck, end to end Meeting Prep Agent Briefing pack before every client meeting Research & modeling Market Researcher Sector or theme → industry overview, competitive landscape, peer comps, ideas shortlist Earnings Reviewer Earnings call + filings → model update → note draft Model Builder DCF, LBO, 3-statement, comps — live in Excel Fund admin & finance ops Valuation Reviewer Ingests GP packages, runs valuation template, stages LP reporting GL Reconciler Finds breaks, traces root cause, routes for sign-off Month-End Closer Accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary Statement Auditor Audits LP statements before distribution Operations & onboarding KYC Screener Parses onboarding docs, runs the rules engine, flags gaps For Managed Agent deployment — agent.yaml, leaf-worker subagents, steering-event examples, and per-agent security notes — see managed-agent-cookbooks/. Repository Layout plugins/ agent-plugins/ # Named agents — one self-contained plugin each vertical-plugins/ # Skill + command bundles by FSI vertical, plus MCP connectors partner-built/ # Partner-authored plugins (LSEG, S&P Global) managed-agent-cookbooks/ # Claude Managed Agent cookbooks — one dir per agent claude-for-msft-365-install/ # Admin tooling to provision the Claude Microsoft 365 add-in scripts/ # deploy-managed-agent.sh · check.py · validate.py · orchestrate.py · sync-agent-skills.py Getting Started Cowork In Cowork, open Settings → Plugins → Add plugin and either: Paste this repo URL — https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services — then pick the agents and verticals you want from the marketplace list, or Upload a zip — zip any directory under plugins/ (e.g. plugins/agent-plugins/pitch-agent/) and drop it in. Claude Code # Add the marketplace claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services # Core skills + connectors (install first) claude plugin install financial-analysis@claude-for-financial-services # Named agents — pick the ones you want claude plugin install pitch-agent@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install gl-reconciler@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install market-researcher@claude-for-financial-services # Vertical skill bundles claude plugin install investment-banking@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install equity-research@claude-for-financial-services Once installed, agents appear in Cowork dispatch, skills fire automatically when relevant, and slash commands are available in your session (/comps, /dcf, /earnings, /ic-memo, …). Claude Managed Agents export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... scripts/deploy-managed-agent.sh gl-reconciler Each template under managed-agent-cookbooks/ references the same system prompt and skills as its plugin counterpart. The deploy script resolves file references, uploads skills, creates leaf-worker subagents, and POSTs the orchestrator to /v1/agents. See scripts/orchestrate.py for a reference event loop that routes handoff_request events between agents via your own orchestration layer. Research Preview: subagent delegation (callable_agents) is a preview capability. See per-agent READMEs for security and handoff guidance. How It Fits Together What it is Where it lives Agents Self-contained plugins that own a workflow end to end — system prompt plus the skills it uses. Cowork and the Managed Agent wrapper both reference the same directory. plugins/agent-plugins/ / Skills Domain expertise, conventions, and step-by-step methods Claude draws on automatically when relevant. Authored once in the verticals; each agent bundles a synced copy of the ones it needs. plugins/vertical-plugins/ /skills/ (source) · plugins/agent-plugins/ /skills/ (bundled) Commands Slash actions you trigger explicitly (/comps, /earnings, /ic-memo). plugins/vertical-plugins/ /commands/ Connectors MCP servers that wire Claude to your data — terminals, research platforms, document stores. plugins/vertical-plugins/financial-analysis/.mcp.json Managed-agent wrappers agent.yaml + depth-1 subagents + steering examples for headless deployment. managed-agent-cookbooks/ / Everything is file-based — markdown and JSON, no build step. Vertical Plugins Start with financial-analysis — it carries the shared modeling skills and all data connectors. Add verticals for the workflows you need. Plugin What it adds financial-analysis (core) Comps, DCF, LBO, 3-statement, deck QC, Excel audit. All 11 data connectors. investment-banking CIMs, teasers, process letters, buyer lists, merger models, deal tracking. equity-research Earnings notes, initiations, model updates, thesis and catalyst tracking. private-equity Sourcing, screening, diligence checklists, IC memos, portfolio monitoring. fund-admin GL recon, break tracing, accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, NAV tie-out. operations KYC document parsing and rules-grid evaluation. claude-for-financial-advisors Advisor workflows: meeting prep and follow-up, compliance pre-check, prospect intake, rebalance review, alts and estate briefs, on live data from the advisor's CRM, portfolio, planning, and estate platforms. lseg (partner) Bond RV, swap curves, FX carry, options vol, macro-rates monitoring on LSEG data. sp-global (partner) Tear sheets, earnings previews, funding digests on S&P Capital IQ. MCP Integrations All connectors are centralized in the financial-analysis core plugin and shared across the rest. Provider URL Daloopa https://mcp.daloopa.com/server/mcp Morningstar https://mcp.morningstar.com/mcp S&P Global https://kfinance.kensho.com/integrations/mcp FactSet https://mcp.factset.com/mcp Moody's https://api.moodys.com/genai-ready-data/m1/mcp MT Newswires https://vast-mcp.blueskyapi.com/mtnewswires Aiera https://mcp-pub.aiera.com LSEG https://api.analytics.lseg.com/lfa/mcp PitchBook https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp Chronograph https://ai.chronograph.pe/mcp Egnyte https://mcp-server.egnyte.com/mcp Box https://mcp.box.com MCP access may require a subscription or API key from the provider. Claude for Microsoft 365 — Install Tooling If your firm runs Claude inside Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook via the Microsoft 365 add-in, claude-for-msft-365-install/ is the admin tooling to provision it against your own cloud — Vertex AI, Bedrock, or an internal LLM gateway — instead of Anthropic's API. It's a Claude Code plugin (not a Cowork plugin) that walks an IT admin through generating the customized add-in manifest, granting Azure admin consent, and writing per-user routing config via Microsoft Graph. Install with: claude plugin install claude-for-msft-365-install@claude-for-financial-services /claude-for-msft-365-install:setup This is separate from the agents and vertical plugins above — it's the on-ramp that gets the add-in deployed in a tenant, after which the agents and skills here are what runs inside it. Making It Yours These are reference templates — they get better when you tune them to how your firm works. Swap connectors — point .mcp.json at your data providers and internal systems. Add firm context — drop your terminology, processes, and formatting standards into skill files. Bring your templates — /ppt-template teaches Claude your branded PowerPoint layouts. Adjust agent scope — edit agents/ .md to match how your team actually runs the workflow. Add your own — copy the structure for workflows we haven't covered. Skill & Command Reference financial-analysis — core modeling, Excel, deck QC Skill Command Description comps-analysis /comps Comparable company analysis with trading multiples dcf-model /dcf DCF valuation with WACC and sensitivity analysis lbo-model /lbo Leveraged buyout model 3-statement-model /3-statement-model Populate 3-statement financial model templates audit-xls /debug-model Excel model audit — formula tracing, hardcode detection, balance checks clean-data-xls — Normalize and clean tabular data in Excel deck-refresh — Re-link and refresh embedded charts/tables across a deck competitive-analysis /competitive-analysis Competitive landscape and market positioning ib-check-deck — QC presentations for errors and consistency pptx-author — Produce a .pptx file headlessly (Managed Agent mode) xlsx-author — Produce a .xlsx file headlessly (Managed Agent mode) ppt-template-creator /ppt-template Create reusable PPT template skills skill-creator — Guide for creating new skills investment-banking — deal materials and execution Skill Command Description strip-profile /one-pager One-page company profiles for pitch books pitch-deck — Populate pitch deck templates with data datapack-builder — Build data packs from CIMs and filings cim-builder /cim Draft Confidential Information Memorandums teaser /teaser Anonymous one-page company teasers buyer-list /buyer-list Strategic and financial buyer universe merger-model /merger-model Accretion/dilution M&A analysis process-letter /process-letter Bid instructions and process correspondence deal-tracker /deal-tracker Track live deals, milestones, and action items equity-research — coverage and publishing Skill Command Description earnings-analysis /earnings Post-earnings quarterly update reports earnings-preview /earnings-preview Pre-earnings scenario analysis and key metrics initiating-coverage /initiate Institutional-quality initiation reports model-update /model-update Update financial models with new data morning-note /morning-note Morning meeting notes and trade ideas sector-overview /sector Industry landscape and thematic reports thesis-tracker /thesis Maintain and update investment theses catalyst-calendar /catalysts Track upcoming catalysts across coverage idea-generation /screen Stock screening and idea sourcing private-equity — sourcing through portfolio ops Skill Command Description deal-sourcing /source Discover companies, check CRM, draft founder outreach deal-screening /screen-deal Quick pass/fail on inbound CIMs and teasers dd-checklist /dd-checklist Diligence checklists by workstream dd-meeting-prep /dd-prep Prep for management presentations and expert calls unit-economics /unit-economics ARR cohorts, LTV/CAC, net retention, revenue quality returns-analysis /returns IRR/MOIC sensitivity tables ic-memo /ic-memo Investment committee memo drafting portfolio-monitoring /portfolio Track portfolio company KPIs and variances value-creation-plan /value-creation Post-close 100-day plans and EBITDA bridges ai-readiness /ai-readiness Assess a portfolio company's AI readiness Contributing Everything here is markdown and YAML. Fork, edit, PR. For new content: New skill → add it under plugins/vertical-plugins/ /skills/, then run python3 scripts/sync-agent-skills.py to propagate to any agent that bundles it. New agent → plugins/agent-plugins/ / (with agents/ .md + skills/) and a matching managed-agent-cookbooks/ /. Run python3 scripts/check.py before pushing — it lints every manifest, verifies all cross-file references resolve, and fails if any bundled skill has drifted from its vertical source. title: agent-substrate/substrate
description: Agent Substrate: the core system Agent Substrate NOTE: This is not an officially supported Google product. This project is not eligible for the Google Open Source Software Vulnerability Rewards Program. What is Agent Substrate? Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes with 10x higher density than standard container runtimes. Purpose-built for the era of autonomous agents, Substrate delivers sub-500ms resume operations at over 500 suspend/resume activations per second with native zero-trust kernel and network isolation. It supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor, enabling consistent lifecycle operations for all sandbox types. At its core, Agent Substrate maps a larger set of “actors” (applications such as agents) onto a smaller set of ready “workers”, relying on the fact that agent-like applications tend to be idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing. It provides functionality to manage an actor’s lifecycle (e.g. create/destroy, suspend/resume), to assign actors to workers in real time, and to route incoming traffic to them. Agent Substrate is intended to be a low-opinion system. The workloads it manages don't have to be literal AI agents, but those are the best example of the kind of applications it is designed for. It is not an SDK for building agents, but rather a system for running them at scale. Agent Substrate leverages Kubernetes for the infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management (Kubernetes Pods). It builds on top of Kubernetes features like Pods and Pod autoscaling, while Agent Substrate provides agent-specific scheduling and control to achieve lower latency. Using Kubernetes as the underlying system enables consistent infrastructure management across all workloads types that are required for end to end agentic deployments and allows holistic infrastructure optimizations for RL scenarios that span agentic, inference and training cycles. Demo Watch the Agent Substrate cluster multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods. This demo highlights the core developer experience and "Agentic Infrastructure" capabilities of Substrate: Actor Teleport: High-performance suspend and resume of actors onto any available worker in the pool with sub-second activation. State Persistence: Persistent working memory (volatile RAM) and filesystem state preserved perfectly across hibernation cycles via full-state snapshots. Agent Multiplexing: Demonstrates 30x+ oversubscription by "juggling" a large registry of stateful actors onto a small pool of shared physical pods. To reproduce this demo in your own cluster, please refer to the detailed walkthrough in the Counter Demo. For more videos and walkthroughs, visit our YouTube channel: agent-substrate. Framework Agnostic & Compatibility Agent Substrate is designed to be framework and agent harness agnostic. Because it manages standard OCI containers at the kernel level (via gVisor), it can host agents built on any stack. Agent Development Kit (ADK): Support for ADK agents with session state preservation across invocations as actor state. Ideal for all types of agents and stateful tool or subagent calls. LangChain: Ideal execution environment for LangChain agents and tool calls. Claude Code, CodeX, and Antigravity: Support for high-density, stateful coding environments that preserve system state and filesystem state across sessions. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Support for deploying secure, sandboxed MCP servers as Substrate Actors to provide durable tools for any model. Ecosystem & Examples Agent Executor: A distributed agent runtime that demonstrates building a secure, hyper-scalable agent harness on Agent Substrate (see the announcement blog and integration guide). kagent: A CNCF Sandbox project and Kubernetes-native framework for building, deploying, and managing AI agents that uses Agent Substrate to run sandboxed, stateful agent workloads (see the announcement blog). Status and compatibility Agent Substrate is currently in early development. It is not ready for production use, and the APIs are almost guaranteed to change. We are not making any guarantees about backward compatibility at this stage, and everything in this project may be changed. Supported Kubernetes Releases Currently we aim to support the latest stable release of Kubernetes, and the previous minor release. Community For announcements, technical discussions, and community support, please join the ate-dev Google Group. We host a weekly community meeting every Thursday from 10:00am - 11:00am PST. Video call link: https://meet.google.com/uhq-cxvn-dhy Or dial: (US) +1 253-289-6971 PIN: 787 664 574 59# More phone numbers: https://tel.meet/uhq-cxvn-dhy?pin=9044088223662 Meeting notes for the weekly sync meeting Recordings and transcripts of all community meetings We also have channels in the CNCF slack; request an invite here if you don't have access. #substrate-users to discuss using substrate. #substrate-dev to discuss developing substrate. Developing Please see CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines on contributing to the project. We welcome contributions of all kinds, but the project is VERY young. Our immediate focus is on building out the core system and demos, so we may not be able to review or merge contributions that don't align with those goals in the near term. Quickstart (Development) To quickly set up the complete environment: Make sure you have Go, kubectl, and docker installed and configured on your dev machine. We will automatically manage other dependencies via Go, including kind. Run the following steps: # create cluster and local registry (IPv4; IP_FAMILY=dual|ipv6 overrides) hack/create-kind-cluster.sh # install ate, PostgreSQL, rustfs hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-ate-system # install counter demo hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-demo-counter # install kubectl-ate go install ./cmd/kubectl-ate # create a counter actor in the demo's atespace (--template names the # actor template, resolved in the actor's atespace) kubectl ate create actor my-counter-1 -a ate-demo-counter --template counter # port-forward the network router to bind to local port `8000` kubectl port-forward -n ate-system svc/atenet-router 8000:80 In a separate terminal, send an HTTP request to increment the counter: curl -X POST \ -H "ate-target-actor: ate-demo-counter/my-counter-1" \ -i http://localhost:8000/ Worker capacity is versioned: the dataplane (the atelet DaemonSet and the worker pods) schedules only on nodes that carry the ate.dev/substrate-version label, and the install stamps it on every node that exists when it runs. A node added later hosts no workers until you label it with the installed version (kubectl label node ate.dev/substrate-version= ). kubectl get ds -n ate-system -l app=atelet -L ate.dev/substrate-version prints the installed version, off the atelet DaemonSet the install created. GKE Quickstart (Development) Create and configure your environment file: cp hack/ate-dev-env.sh.example .ate-dev-env.sh # Edit .ate-dev-env.sh to match your project and preferences, then source it: source .ate-dev-env.sh Enable application-default credentials for gcloud: gcloud auth application-default login --project=${PROJECT_ID} Provision the required GCP resources (GKE cluster, GCS, and IAM bindings): go run ./tools/setup-gcp bootstrap On a fresh project this step also creates the atelet Workload Identity IAM grants that snapshots depend on — see what create iam actually grants to audit them or apply them manually. If you bring your own cluster instead, note the required Kubernetes beta APIs can only be enabled at cluster creation — see the Create Cluster warning. Deploy the Agent Substrate system to your cluster: ./hack/install-ate.sh --deploy-ate-system Nodes that GKE adds later (autoscaling, auto-repair, node upgrades) are born with the node pool's labels, so the pool needs ate.dev/substrate-version too; see Node version labels. You can then deploy the sample applications. See demos/counter/README.md or demos/sandbox/README.md for detailed walkthroughs. ./hack/install-ate.sh --deploy-demo-counter Custom Setup and Deployment You can run individual setup steps to create GCP resources as needed. See go run ./tools/setup-gcp --help for available options. For example: go run ./tools/setup-gcp create cluster go run ./tools/setup-gcp create bucket To run the PostgreSQL store backend on Cloud SQL — with IAM database authentication and no passwords — see tools/setup-gcp/cloud-sql.md. Similarly, you can deploy or cleanup specific Agent Substrate components using the installation script. See ./hack/install-ate.sh --help for all options. # Re-deploy only ate-apiserver of the ATE system ./hack/install-ate.sh --deploy-ate-apiserver # Delete everything (core system and all demos) ./hack/install-ate.sh --delete-all Tearing down resources (GCP) If you need to delete the resources created by the setup script, you can use the provided script hack/teardown.sh. This script will delete resources in the reverse order of creation and handles partial failures gracefully. ./hack/teardown.sh --all Or run individual teardown steps as needed (see ./hack/teardown.sh for available options). Tearing down local kind resources If you need to delete the local kind cluster and its registry (if it was created by hack/create-kind-cluster.sh): ./hack/delete-kind-cluster.sh Demos We provide several sample applications demonstrating Agent Substrate's capabilities: Counter Demo: A stateful Go HTTP server demonstrating state preservation across suspends/resumes, and on-demand actor resumption and routing via the Substrate router. Sandbox Demo (Antigravity): A secure, sandboxed execution environment (running Alpine Linux) that allows arbitrary shell execution while preserving filesystem state across sessions. Claude Code Multiplex: Demonstrates oversubscribing physical hardware by multiplexing multiple Claude Code agents onto a limited pool of workers. Multi-Template: Two ActorTemplates running different binaries share one WorkerPool, even though the templates live in different atespaces. Request Parking: An oversubscribed pool where the router holds inbound requests until a worker frees up, instead of returning 503. Autoscaled WorkerPool: Scales a WorkerPool on its assigned-worker count with an HPA fed by prometheus-adapter. Documentation & Guides Architecture: How the control plane, node supervisor, and networking stack fit together. API Configuration Guide: Detailed reference for configuring WorkerPools, ActorTemplates, Secrets, and Volumes. Full CLI Documentation: Installation and usage for kubectl-ate. Glossary: Core terms (Actor, Atespace, ActorTemplate, WorkerPool, Worker, ate-api-server, atenet, atelet, ateom) and how they relate. Integration Repositories: Where integrations live, how their repositories are named, and how fixes flow back to core. Observability Guide: Guide to actor logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. Authentication Guide: Configure trusted JWT providers and human credentials. Egress Traffic: Which protocols an Actor may reach the outside world with and which are blocked. Enabling man-in-the-middle (MITM) interception for Actor Egress policy: Egress policies such as header injection depend on MITM interception of Actor traffic. This guide explains how an Actor should be configured to enable interception. Request Parking: How the router parks requests through transient worker-pool saturation. Rolling Upgrade Runbook: Upgrade a running substrate node by node without losing actor state. Threat Model: Trust boundaries, assumptions, and known risks. Roadmap: Current limitations and what is planned next. Benchmarking Guide: Locust-based load tests, monitoring stack, and the orchestrated benchmark harness. Tour Commands cmd/ateapi: The core control plane API server exposing gRPC endpoints to manage actor and worker lifecycles. cmd/atelet: A node-level DaemonSet that supervises physical worker pods, coordinates snapshotting, and manages state transfers. cmd/atecontroller: A Kubernetes controller that reconciles WorkerPool custom resources. cmd/atenet: A combined networking controller providing Envoy routing and proxy sidecars. cmd/ateom-gvisor: An interior-pod helper running inside sandboxed worker pods to execute runsc checkpoint and restore commands. cmd/ateom-microvm: The micro-VM peer of ateom-gvisor, running actors as cloud-hypervisor VMs. cmd/podcertcontroller: A "polyfill" that provides Pod Certificate signers that will eventually ship in upstream Kubernetes (with different names). cmd/kubectl-ate: A CLI tool for managing Agent Substrate resources. See its README. cmd/benchmarking: Synthetic workloads used by the load tests, including glutton, which consumes RAM, disk, and file descriptors on demand. tools/setup-gcp: A provisioning utility to set up the necessary GCP infrastructure resources (GKE, GCS, IAM). demos/: Sample applications demonstrating Agent Substrate capabilities.
